newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X says Merukh lawsuit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X says Merukh lawsuit without merit.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday that a lawsuit launched yesterday by its Indonesian partner is without merit.
"We believe that this lawsuit is frivolous, completely without merit and we intend to contest it vigorously," Bre-X chief executive David Walsh said in a statement.
Bre-X acknowledged that the company and certain of its executives are the subject of a lawsuit filed in Alberta's Court of Queen's Bench by PT Krueng Gasui, headed by Jusuf Merukh.
The C$2 billion suit is also directed against 19 other parties, including certain Indonesian and other foreign companies.
Merukh is claiming up to 40 percent of the entire Busang property. He has an uncontested 10 percent interest in a small section of the Busang deposit.
